events.title: Festivalpass med NATTEN Slottsfjell 2027
events.description: Slottsfjell har flyttet ned fra fjellet til vakre Kaldnes, kun fire minutters gange fra legendariske Tønsberg Brygge. På området opplever du fremtidens festival midt i sentrum av Norges beste sommerby, Tønsberg. Omkranset av skjærgård byr vi på en bred og spennende musikkprofil på store utendørsscener, nattklubb og vår egen strand. Når du vil trekke deg tilbake har vi flere loungeområder og en gigantisk mathall hvor du kan nyte mat fra hele verden med vennene dine. Når solen går ned, og lyden fra hovedscenen har stilnet, presenterer vi Norges største nattklubb - NATTEN! Festivalpasset inkluderer NATTEN og har 20 års aldersgrense - gyldig ID kreves! Portene åpner kl. 13:00 hver dag. NATTEN åpner kl. 21:00 Ledsager gratis mot fremvisning av gyldig ledsagerbevis. For mer informasjon om artistslipp, program og praktiske opplysninger se Slottsfjells hjemmeside og facebookside

events.title: Festivalpass uten Natten Slottsfjell 2027
events.description: Slottsfjell is a rock- and pop festival located at Slottsfjellet in Tønsberg where stages and public areas is constructed amongst the ruins of the medieval fortress Tunsberghus on Slottsfjellet and the surrounding area. There are also concerts in other venues in the city. This festival pass is ONLY for those over 18 years - valid ID required! HC Companion is free if valid escort certificate can be presented at the entrance. The gates open at. 13:00 every day. For more information about artist announcments, program and practical information, see Slottsfjell's homepage og facebookpage. Also, check the mood of previous festivals on their YouTube channel.

events.title: Camp Utgard - Camp Ticket
events.description: Camp ticket for 1 person, everyone needs a camp ticket to gain entry to the camp. Camp ticket All Days is valid from Monday 16. august Please note: The Camp ticket is only valid with a festival ticket. Age limit for Camp Utgard is 18 Yrs. Tent tickets are sold separately. By the gravemounds in the park of Borre where Norway's Viking chiefs were laid to rest, we welcome you to 4 days of metal, folk, pagan, dark ambient, craftbeers, markets, museum, seminars, Viking village and battles on historic grounds - welcome to the world of the Vikings! Changes to the program may occur. Cancellation of artists/bands and subsequent program changes will not entitle you to a refund of your ticket. Food service: Yes HC Companion: Regular ticket Age limit: 18 Accessibility: No Parking: Yes For more information see www.midgardsblot.no og Facebook

events.title: Camp Utgard - Tent Ticket
events.description: Tent place for 1 tent at Camp Utgard, max. tent size is 4x4 meter. The tent ticket is valid for the whole period the camp is open. You need to bring your own tent and camping equipment. Plese note: The tent ticket is only valid with both a camp ticket (either an ALL DAYS or a 4 DAYS camp ticket) and a festival ticket. Camp Utgard is only for festival attendees. Age limit for the camp is 18 Yrs. events.title: Midgardsblot Festival Pass 2027
events.description: Midgardsblot 2027 -- Where Metal Meets Myth August 18--21, 2027 Borre Park and Midgard Vikingsenter, Horten, Norway Midgardsblot returns to the historic grounds of Borre, where Viking burial mounds, the Oslofjord, heavy music and ancient traditions meet. Set in one of Norway's most important Viking landscapes, Midgardsblot is more than a music festival. It is four days of metal, folk, rituals, history, fire, community and living heritage --- a gathering unlike any other. Join us at Borre for extreme metal, Nordic folk, experimental sounds, Viking culture, battle reenactments, storytelling, lectures, workshops, markets, rituals and the full Camp Utgard experience by the fjord. Experience Midgardsblot: Opening Blót ritual Extreme metal, folk and experimental music Viking village and market Living history, crafts and reenactment Viking battles and demonstrations Talks, storytelling and cultural program Festival camp by the Oslofjord Food, bars, merch and festival community Early Bird tickets are available now in a limited quantity. Get your ticket early and be part of the next chapter of the Blot. Event time / concert start: 14:00 Doors open: 14:00 Age limit: No age limit Companion: Free without ticket Accessibility: Yes Parking: Yes Compagnion : Free without ticket Accessibility for people with reduced mobility: Yes Parking available: Yes For more information see www.midgardsblot.no and Facebook
